goal: Minimize reasoning dead time without paid API or always-on user PC while preserving disposable-worker semantics.

layers.mechanism: Current owner checkpoints meaningful work and emits one next-generation event on dedicated PR lane before observed runtime boundary.
layers.gate: Provision a ChatGPT Work GitHub PR commit-update trigger, then pass state/EVENT_WORKER_PROBE.json.

layers.target_latency: <=5m schedule interval plus GitHub/Work delivery delay
layers.mechanism: Public-repo GitHub Actions checks durable liveness every 5 minutes and emits at most one PR-lane rescue commit only when event lane is ACTIVE, program is nonterminal, owner progress stale >=180s and no generation outstanding.
layers.schedule_observation: No schedule-triggered run visible through 01:14; first scheduled execution remains unproven.

layers.target_latency: <=15m after current invocation releases plus scheduler delay
layers.mechanism: Existing canonical scheduled task rotates BYMINUTE across quarter phases.
layers.live_evidence: Epoch 18 remained active across the 01:15 due. After 01:15 automation last_run_time was still the prior 00:59:19 run and no successor handoff request existed. Current owner recovered schedule forward to 01:30.
layers.implication: Do not design zero-gap baton transfer around one canonical overlapping itself unless future positive evidence overturns this observation.

nonnegotiable_invariants: GitHub main is durable source of truth
duplicate wake never implies duplicate substantive side effect
wake event alone never advances authority
no secrets in public event lane
quarter fallback remains enabled until faster layers prove safe

capability_evidence.plugin_permission_setting: GitHub plugin is configured Allow all actions.
capability_evidence.official_event_task_permission_rule: OpenAI documentation states connected-app permissions, workspace controls and approval requirements continue to apply to event-triggered Work tasks.
capability_evidence.interpretation: Write parity is plausible but one live event-worker write/readback probe remains required.

current_blocker: A genuinely independent fast wake domain is now P0 architecture, not an optimization. The current tool surface cannot provision the Work GitHub event trigger, and the guarded Actions producer has no consumer until that trigger exists.
next_test: Keep hard continuation gate for long single-run utilization. Independently validate event-trigger provisioning/write surface; do not rely on same-canonical overlap for baton transfer.
